title: knowledge-turso: a narrow record-only scope goes straight to the exact scan instead of paying for the one-bit pass first
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of #38066 (the seat's ruling B, comment 7236023531; named out of the os-dev report 7235999186) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p3 (suggested: a speed-up; recall is unaffected) · reach: every Turso store with the one-bit index on, for a search whose scope is record ids only and keeps a small share of passages · evidence: measured in the #38066 report 7235999186 at 200k x 1536 (clustered synthetic, topK 10, 50 queries per share) on origin/main e3bdc74884. Under a record-only scope the floor-8 path costs p95 303 / 381 / 419 ms at 10 / 15 / 20% in scope. The exact scan alone, which F3's record index (PR #38160) now limits to the rows in scope, costs 128 / 207 / 265 ms.
Dedupe: `is:issue knowledge-turso record scope exact index one-bit pass` → checked at filing; open: #38066 (the parent) only.
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：F3 加了按记录的索引后，"只看少量指定记录"的检索直接逐条比对已经很快(约 0.13 到 0.27 秒)。但现在仍先跑一遍近似检索，不够再逐条比对，总共约 0.3 到 0.42 秒，反而更慢。
- 做什么：范围只按记录、而且很窄时，直接逐条比对；范围宽时仍用近似检索。分界点要实测。
- 谁受益：权限范围窄的用户在大知识库里的检索速度。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
In `packages/plugins/knowledge-turso/src/turso-adapter.ts`, when the scope is record ids only (no parent term) and the in-scope share is narrow, skip the approximate leg and run the exact scan, which the record index already limits to the rows in scope. Choose the cut-over by measurement. It can be a share estimate, or a threshold on the scope's id count relative to the source's passage count. Wider shares keep the approximate leg: at 50% the exact scan reads 100k rows and the one-bit pass wins.

## Acceptance
- Real-store bench (200k x 1536, topK 10, 50 record-only scoped queries per share) at 5, 10, 20, 35 and 50% in scope: at every share, p95 is no worse than the better of today's path and the exact scan alone, and recall@10 is at least today's.
- The cut-over's position is stated with the measurement that placed it.
- With the direct-exact branch ablated, the bench's narrow-share p95 goes back to today's (the pin).
- Parent-scoped searches keep #38066's path.

Blocked-by: #38066
